title: UNIFIL residual transition liabilities and service continuity
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: The retained UNIFIL budget describes six months of operations followed by drawdown. GA directive extracts call for separation-cost information, environmental/site measures and safe orderly withdrawal; residual liabilities are not quantified.
testable_mechanism: Trace outstanding commitments, staff liabilities, site remediation, asset handover and intermission services through drawdown to identify controllable late costs or avoidable procurement while preserving successor obligations.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Use an approved cancel/retain/transfer review of each commitment and integrated service handover, with liabilities explicitly assigned; retain necessary contracts and capabilities where termination would increase total cost or risk.
safeguards: Protect personnel safety, mandated observation and essential intermission medical/communications services
Meet environmental, property, separation and contractual obligations
No cancellation, disposal, mission withdrawal change or asset transfer without competent authorization
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Six-month operations cannot be annualized as recurring savings. Include termination, separation, freight, disposal, remediation, residual contracts, stranded assets and receiving-mission costs. Existing withdrawal and C02 transferred-asset benefits belong in the baseline; overlap cannot be added.
minimum_records: Open PO/contract and invoice register with delivery dates, cancellation clauses, reversals and closeout status
Personnel separation/redeployment liabilities and approved withdrawal milestones
Asset title/condition/transfer/receipt and receiving-office procurement or service requirements
Site remediation assessments, environmental and property obligations, service agreements and residual risk register
custodian_roles_to_confirm: UNIFIL transition/liquidation and mission support leadership
UNIFIL finance, HR, procurement, property and environmental custodians
Receiving-mission service owners and competent mandate/budget authorities

source_snapshot.directive_paraphrase: Provide comprehensive information on separation costs during drawdown and withdrawal
Ensure environmental and site-closure measures before property transfer
Ensure orderly safe accountable withdrawal and personnel safety

source_snapshot.mandate_or_cost_guardrail: Six-month operational budget cannot be annualized to recurring saving

source_snapshot.mandate_or_cost_guardrail: No assumed savings from mandated withdrawal

case_specific_limit: Historical UNAMI and UNSOM/UNTMIS audit cases demonstrate possible transition-control mechanisms; they are not evidence that UNIFIL incurred those amounts or failures.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
